method: breaths by loudness (under -20 dB for 0.2 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 10 of 23 breaks heard

lines.english: To thee do we cry, poor banished

lines.latin: Ad te suspirámus, geméntes et flentes
lines.english: To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping

lines.latin: Eia ergo, Advocáta nostra, illos tuos misericórdes óculos
lines.english: Turn, then, most gracious advocate, thine eyes of mercy

lines.latin: Et Jesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui,
lines.english: and Jesus, the blessed fruit of thy womb,

lines.latin: Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génitrix.
lines.english: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

lines.latin: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui gloriósæ Vírginis Matris Maríæ corpus et ánimam, ut dignum Fílii tui habitáculum éffici mererétur, Spíritu Sancto cooperánte præparásti:
lines.english: Almighty, everlasting God, who by the co-operation of the Holy Ghost didst prepare the body and soul of the glorious Virgin Mother Mary to become a worthy dwelling for Thy Son:

lines.latin: da, ut cujus commemoratióne lætámur, ejus pia intercessióne ab instántibus malis et a morte perpétua liberémur.
lines.english: grant that we who rejoice in her commemoration may by her loving intercession be delivered from present evils and from everlasting death.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
